title: WARNING... IT IS ONLY ONE CAP, not multiples
text:
WARNING... IT IS ONLY ONE CAP, not multiples. Looking at the picture, you would think it was multiple caps, but it is just as described in the title.... A Cap... One. So,aside from the misleading picture, the cap is not what was described. It was supposed to be a cap with a rubber or plastic insert, which could be reused, but it came with a cardboard insert that can most likely only be used once.
I issued a complaint to the seller, but got no response, and at the price point it's not worth the effort, but if you are looking for multiple growler caps, go to another seller.
